family.shared_definition: a formal academic or professional meeting for discussion of a particular topic
family.neutral_stem: Scholars registered months in advance for
family.semantic_notes: 'Conference' is broad and common across corporate and academic fields, whereas 'symposium' is more exclusively scholarly and topic-focused.

source_context_dev: University departments across the continent pooled their travel budgets to present peer-reviewed findings. The large convention center prepared dozens of lecture halls for the multi-track presentation schedule.

Doctoral candidates and tenured faculty members finalized their slide decks to share original laboratory research. Organizers coordinated poster sessions and roundtable workshops across several adjoining halls.

The committee reviewed hundreds of blind-reviewed abstracts submitted by university laboratories worldwide. Attendees arranged travel stipends through their respective departmental chairs to present their papers.

Scholarly societies coordinated the annual exchange of peer-reviewed monographs and experimental data. Several research institutions sponsored the sprawling multi-day gathering to encourage disciplinary collaboration.
target_context_dev: The dates on the calendar were fast approaching, prompting delegates to secure travel arrangements before hotel blocks sold out. A tight schedule of roundtable dialogues was slated for early next month.
With the event scheduled to open in just a few short weeks, the planning committee finalized the agenda for the focused dialogue. Travel bookings increased as the opening plenary session drew near.
Organizers sent urgent reminders as registration deadlines approached on the shared itinerary. The imminent gathering promised focused panel discussions on targeted research questions.
Anticipation grew as the approaching weekend on the scholarly calendar drew near. Attendees made sure their travel itineraries were settled for the scheduled panel talks.

target_context_test: With only weeks remaining on the calendar, participants rushed to lock in early-bird lodging rates. The impending gathering featured intimate single-track discussions among leading theorists.

The calendar date was fast approaching, and delegates finalized their travel logistics to avoid last-minute delays. A tightly structured day of focused roundtables awaited the participants.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: Both 'academic' and 'upcoming' modify 'conference' and 'symposium' naturally. Source contexts focus on university peer-reviewed research and sprawling multi-track schedules (pragmatically tilting toward 'academic conference'), while target contexts emphasize calendar proximity and focused panel assemblies (tilting toward 'upcoming symposium'). Under all contexts, all four combinations (academic conference, academic symposium, upcoming conference, upcoming symposium) are semantically valid and grammatically sound.

Source contexts emphasize elite exclusivity, low acceptance rates, and reputation (favoring 'prestigious conference'), whereas target contexts emphasize nationwide representation and domestic interstate governance (favoring 'national symposium').

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four cross-combinations ('specialized conference', 'specialized symposium', 'formal conference', 'formal symposium') are natural English expressions. Source contexts leverage niche technical domain specificity (biasing toward 'specialized conference'), while target contexts emphasize ceremonial protocol, dress codes, and parliamentary decorum (biasing toward 'formal symposium'). Neither noun nor modifier is explicitly named.
